memories.title: Absolute positioning owned by toolkit
memories.context: Original implementation had UI calculating room offsets. Different clients could calculate differently.
options: Toolkit owns positioning with absolute coords
memories.chosen: Toolkit owns positioning with absolute coords
memories.reasoning: Toolkit owns all rules including spatial. API stores what toolkit provides. Client renders directly. No math duplication.
consequences: Rooms have absolute offsets in dungeon-space
API stores and returns absolute coords

memories.title: Cube coordinates for hex grids
memories.context: Hex grids need a coordinate system. Multiple options exist.
memories.reasoning: No ambiguity, clean math, constraint q+r+s=0 catches errors. Industry standard for hex grids.
consequences: All positions use (q, r, s) tuples

memories.title: Room origin calculation approach
memories.context: Need to calculate absolute room positions during dungeon generation. Toolkit already does this in GraphGenerator but API dungeon component generates rooms independently.
options: Option A: BFS in dungeon generator using connection directions + room dimensions
Option B: Wire toolkit GraphGenerator into dungeon component directly
memories.chosen: Option A: BFS in dungeon generator
memories.reasoning: Simpler to implement. Dungeon generator already has rooms and connections with directions. BFS from start room using direction + room size gives deterministic origins. Option B is more correct but requires significant refactoring of how the dungeon component interfaces with toolkit environments.
consequences: Dungeon generator calculates origins after room+connection generation
Origins stored on dungeon.Room or as separate map
Must match toolkit's BFS logic for consistency

memories.title: Phased implementation instead of monolithic PR
memories.context: Previous attempt (API PR #400) was closed — too large a change. Need incremental, testable approach.
options: Phased: API first, then UI in stages
memories.chosen: Phased: 5 phases with strict dependency chain
memories.reasoning: Smaller PRs are reviewable. Each phase is independently testable. API phase unblocks all UI work. Previous monolithic attempt failed.
consequences: 5 phases: API origin -> UI accumulate -> UI render -> UI camera -> UI navigation
API phase is the critical path blocker

memories.title: API PR #400 closed without merge
memories.description: Previous unified coordinate system PR was closed. Approach was sound (BFS room positions, absolute coords) but the PR was too large. New plan breaks it into phases.
memories.impact: No blocker — new phased plan supersedes this approach.
